description: Add a split transaction: one bank-facing total spread across multiple categories. The split amounts must sum to the total.

allow_duplicate.description: Create it even though a transaction with the same account, date and total already exists. The total is what a duplicate repeats; how it is divided is internal.

amount.description: Total amount (negative for expenses, positive for income). Must equal the sum of the splits.

date.description: Transaction date (YYYY-MM-DD or "today", "yesterday"). Defaults to today.

splits.description: Two or more splits whose amounts sum to the total.

amount.description: Split amount (same sign as the total). Human amounts, not cents.

name: create_split_transaction
